name: Wine Whey
description: Historical recipe from Miss Leslie's Complete Cookery (1851). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

ingredients.name: a large glass of sherry or Madeira
ingredients.originalText: a large glass of sherry or Madeira
ingredients.quantityText: a large glass of sherry or Madeira

instructions.text: Boil a pint of milk; and when it rises to the top of the sauce-pan, pour in a large glass of sherry or Madeira.
Add a glass of currant wine also.
Let it again boil up, and then take the sauce-pan off the fire, and set it aside to stand for a few minutes, but do not stir it.
Remove the curd, (if it has completely formed,) and pour the clear whey into a bowl and sweeten it.

source.author: Eliza Leslie
source.originalInstructions:
1. Boil a pint of milk; and when it rises to the top of the sauce-pan, pour in a large glass of sherry or Madeira.
2. Add a glass of currant wine also.
3. Let it again boil up, and then take the sauce-pan off the fire, and set it aside to stand for a few minutes, but do not stir it.
4. Remove the curd, (if it has completely formed,) and pour the clear whey into a bowl and sweeten it.
